```python
from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeslaWavesExplanation(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0a0a1a"
        
        # ===== TITLE =====
        title = Text("Tesla's Waves", font_size=48, color=BLUE_C)
        subtitle = Text("Wireless Power & Resonance", font_size=28, color=GRAY_B)
        subtitle.next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        title_group = VGroup(title, subtitle)
        title_group.center()
        
        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP*0.2), run_time=1)
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(title_group), run_time=1)
        
        # ===== SECTION 1: Electromagnetic Waves =====
        section1_title = Text("1. Electromagnetic Waves", font_size=36, color=TEAL_C)
        section1_title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(section1_title), run_time=1)
        
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 10, 1],
            y_range=[-2, 2, 1],
            x_length=9,
            y_length=3,
            axis_config={"include_tip": False, "color": GRAY_D},
        ).shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        x_label = MathTex("x", color=GRAY_C).next_to(axes.x_axis.get_end(), RIGHT)
        e_label = MathTex("E", color=YELLOW_C).next_to(axes.y_axis.get_end(), UP)
        
        self.play(Create(axes), Write(x_label), Write(e_label), run_time=1.5)
        
        e_wave = always_redraw(lambda: axes.plot(
            lambda x: 1.5 * np.sin(2 * x - self.renderer.time * 3),
            x_range=[0, 10],
            color=YELLOW_C,
            stroke_width=3
        ))
        
        b_wave = always_redraw(lambda: axes.plot(
            lambda x: 0.8 * np.cos(2 * x - self.renderer.time * 3),
            x_range=[0, 10],
            color=BLUE_C,
            stroke_width=3
        ).shift(DOWN*1.5))
        
        b_label = Text("B-field", font_size=20, color=BLUE_C).to_edge(RIGHT).shift(UP*1)
        e_label_text = Text("E-field", font_size=20, color=YELLOW_C).to_edge(RIGHT).shift(UP*2.5)
        
        self.play(Create(e_wave), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(Create(b_wave), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(Write(e_label_text), Write(b_label), run_time=0.5)
        
        em_formula = MathTex(r"c = f \lambda", font_size=32, color=WHITE)
        em_formula.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(em_formula), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(axes, x_label, e_label, e_wave, b_wave, b_label, e_label_text, em_formula), run_time=1)
        
        # ===== SECTION 2: Tesla's Resonant Oscillator =====
        section2_title = Text("2. Tesla's Resonant Oscillator", font_size=36, color=TEAL_C)
        section2_title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(section1_title, section2_title), run_time=1)
        
        battery = Rectangle(height=0.4, width=0.8, color=RED_C, fill_opacity=0.3)
        battery_label = Text("V", font_size=20, color=RED_C).move_to(battery)
        cap_plate1 = Line(LEFT*0.5, RIGHT*0.5, color=YELLOW_C, stroke_width=4)
        cap_plate2 = Line(LEFT*0.5, RIGHT*0.5, color=YELLOW_C, stroke_width=4)
        cap_plate2.next_to(cap_plate1, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        capacitor = VGroup(cap_plate1, cap_plate2)
        
        inductor = ArcBetweenPoints(LEFT*0.3, RIGHT*0.3, angle=PI/2, color=GREEN_C, stroke_width=3)
        for i in range(1, 5):
            arc = ArcBetweenPoints(LEFT*0.3 + RIGHT*0.15*i, RIGHT*0.3 + RIGHT*0.15*(i-1), angle=-PI/2, color=GREEN_C, stroke_width=3)
            inductor.add(arc)
        
        battery.shift(LEFT*3 + DOWN*1)
        battery_label.move_to(battery)
        capacitor.shift(RIGHT*2 + UP*1)
        inductor.shift(RIGHT*2 + DOWN*1)
        
        wire1 = Line(battery.get_top(), battery.get_top() + UP*2, color=GRAY_C)
        wire2 = Line(wire1.get_end(), capacitor.get_left(), color=GRAY_C)
        wire3 = Line(capacitor.get_right(), inductor.get_right(), color=GRAY_C)
        wire4 = Line(inductor.get_left(), battery.get_bottom(), color=GRAY_C)
        
        circuit = VGroup(battery, battery_label, capacitor, inductor, wire1, wire2, wire3, wire4)
        circuit.center().shift(DOWN*0.5)
        
        self.play(Create(circuit), run_time=2)
        
        current_dot = Dot(color=RED, radius=0.08)
        current_dot.move_to(battery.get_center())
        
        def oscillate_dot(mob, dt):
            t = self.renderer.time
            phase = (np.sin(t * 4) * 0.5 + 0.5)
            mob.move_to(battery.get_center() + (capacitor.get_center() - battery.get_center()) * phase)
        
        current_dot.add_updater(oscillate_dot)
        self.add(current_dot)
        
        resonance_formula = MathTex(r"f = \frac{1}{2\pi\sqrt{LC}}", font_size=32, color=WHITE)
        resonance_formula.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(resonance_formula), run_time=1)
        
        resonance_text = Text("Resonance: Energy swaps between Capacitor & Inductor", font_size=22, color=GRAY_B)
        resonance_text.next_to(circuit, DOWN, buff=1.2)
        self.play(Write(resonance_text), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(circuit, current_dot, resonance_formula, resonance_text), run_time=1)
        
        # ===== SECTION 3: Tesla Coil =====
        section3_title = Text("3. Tesla Coil", font_size=36, color=TEAL_C)
        section3_title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(section2_title, section3_title), run_time=1)
        
        primary = VGroup()
        for i in range(3):
            spiral = Arc(radius=0.5 + i*0.3, angle=TAU*0.8, color=BLUE_E, stroke_width=3)
            primary.add(spiral)
        primary.shift(LEFT*2 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        secondary = VGroup()
        for i in range(8):
            loop = Ellipse(width=0.4, height=0.15, color=YELLOW_C, stroke_width=2)
            loop.shift(RIGHT*1.5 + DOWN*1 + UP*i*0.25)
            secondary.add(loop)
        
        toroid = Ellipse(width=1.2, height=0.3, color=GOLD_C, stroke_width=4)
        toroid.move_to(secondary[-1].get_center() + UP*0.2)
        
        tesla_coil = VGroup(primary, secondary, toroid)
        tesla_coil.center().shift(DOWN*0.3)
        
        self.play(Create(primary), run_time=1)
        self.play(Create(secondary), run_time=1)
        self.play(Create(toroid), run_time=0.5)
        
        arcs = VGroup()
        for i in range(3):
            arc = ArcBetweenPoints(
                toroid.get_top() + LEFT*0.2 + RIGHT*0.2*i,
                toroid.get_top() + UP*1.5 + RIGHT*(np.random.random()-0.5),
                angle=(np.random.random()-0.5)*PI,
                color=BLUE_B,
                stroke_width=2
            )
            arcs.add(arc)
        
        self.add(arcs)
        self.play(FadeIn(arcs), run_time=0.5)
        
        coil_text = Text("High Voltage, High Frequency Oscillations", font_size=24, color=GRAY_B)
        coil_text.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(coil_text), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(tesla_coil, arcs, coil_text), run_time=1)
        
        # ===== SECTION 4: Earth as Resonant Conductor =====
        section4_title = Text("4. Earth as a Resonant Conductor", font_size=36, color=TEAL_C)
        section4_title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(section3_title, section4_title), run_time=1)
        
        earth = Circle(radius=2, color=BLUE_D, fill_opacity=0.2, stroke_width=3)
        earth.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        earth_label = Text("Earth", font_size=24, color=BLUE_B).move_to(earth)
        
        ionosphere = DashedVMobject(Arc(radius=3.5, angle=PI, start_angle=PI, color=BLUE_B, stroke_width=2), num_dashes=20)
        ionosphere.shift(DOWN*0.5)
        ion_label = Text("Ionosphere", font_size=20, color=BLUE_B).next_to(ionosphere, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Create(earth), Write(earth_label), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(ionosphere), Write(ion_label), run_time=1.5)
        
        standing_wave = always_redraw(lambda: VGroup(*[
            Line(
                earth.point_at_angle(PI/2 + 0.2*i) + UP*0.1,
                earth.point_at_angle(PI/2 + 0.2*i) + UP*(1.2 + 0.8*np.sin(5*0.2*i + self.renderer.time*3)),
                color=YELLOW_C,
                stroke_width=2,
                stroke_opacity=0.6
            ) for i in range(-10, 11)
        ]))
        
        self.play(Create(standing_wave), run_time=1)
        
        earth_text = Text("Standing waves can circulate around the globe", font_size=22, color=GRAY_B)
        earth_text.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.5)
        self.play(Write(earth_text), run_time=1)
        
        schumann = MathTex(r"f_n = \frac{c}{2\pi R_E} \sqrt{n(n+1)}", font_size=28, color=WHITE)
        schumann.next_to(earth_text, UP, buff=0.3)
        self.play(Write(schumann), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(3)
        self.play(FadeOut(earth, earth_label, ionosphere, ion_label, standing_wave, earth_text, schumann), run_time=1)
        
        # ===== SECTION 5: Wardenclyffe Tower Concept =====
        section5_title = Text("5. The Vision: Wardenclyffe Tower", font_size=36, color=TEAL_C)
        section5_title.to_edge(UP, buff=0.5)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(section4_title, section5_title), run_time=1)
        
        tower_base = Rectangle(height=0.3, width=1.5, color=GRAY_C, fill_opacity=0.3)
        tower_pole = Rectangle(height=2.5, width=0.2, color=GRAY_C, fill_opacity=0.3)
        tower_pole.next_to(tower_base, UP, buff=0)
        tower_dome = Arc(radius=0.6, angle=PI, color=GOLD_C, stroke_width=3)
        tower_dome.next_to(tower_pole, UP, buff=0)
        tower = VGroup(tower_base, tower_pole, tower_dome)
        tower.shift(LEFT*2 + DOWN*0.5)
        
        house = Square(side_length=0.8, color=GREEN_C, fill_opacity=0.3)
        roof = Triangle(color=RED_C, fill_opacity=0.3).scale(0.5).next_to(house, UP, buff=0)
        receiver = VGroup(house, roof)
        receiver.shift(RIGHT*2.5 + DOWN*0.8)
        
        self.play(Create(tower), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(Create(receiver), run_time=1)
        
        waves = VGroup()
        for i in range(5):
            wave = Arc(radius=0.5 + i*0.4, angle=PI/3, start_angle=PI*7/12, color=BLUE_B, stroke_width=2, stroke_opacity=0.7-i*0.1)
            wave.move_to(tower_dome.get_top())
            waves.add(wave)
        
        self.add(waves)
        self.play(FadeIn(waves), run_time=1)
        
        for _ in range(2):
            traveling_wave = Arc(radius=0.5, angle=PI/3, start_angle=PI*7/12, color=YELLOW_C, stroke_width=3)
            traveling_wave.move_to(tower_dome.get_top())
            self.add(traveling_wave)
            self.play(traveling_wave.animate.scale(3).set_opacity(0), run_time=1.5)
            self.remove(traveling_wave)
        
        final_text1 = Text("Transmit power without wires", font_size=24, color=GRAY_B)
        final_text1.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.7)
        final_text2 = Text("Using resonant electromagnetic waves", font_size=22, color=GRAY_C)
        final_text2.next_to(final_text1, UP, buff=0.2)
        
        self.play(Write(final_text2), run_time=1)
        self.play(Write(final_text1), run_time=1)
        
        self.wait(2)
        self.play(FadeOut(section5_title, tower, receiver, waves, final_text1, final_text2), run_time=1.5)
        
        # ===== END =====
        end_title = Text("Tesla's Waves", font_size=44, color=BLUE_C)
        end_subtitle = Text("Resonance, Oscillation, and Wireless Vision", font_size=26, color=GRAY_B)
        end_subtitle.next_to(end_title, DOWN, buff=0.3)
        end_group = VGroup(end_title, end_subtitle)
        end_group.center()
        
        self.play(Write(end_title), run_time=1.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(end_subtitle), run_time=1)
        self.wait(2)
```
